what_this_is: The single authoritative state of the Livdar Atlas offline inventory, reconstructed from repository artifacts on 2026-10-21. Every number is recomputed from the git-tracked manifest parts by scripts/atlas/verify-1m-manifest.py and scripts/atlas/classify-demand-basis.py, not copied from a summary or from conversation memory.
definition_of_FINAL_DISTINCT_VALID: Rows in LIVDAR-1M-CANDIDATE-MANIFEST: every candidate that survived every quality gate of scripts/atlas/scale/build-1m-candidate-manifest.py, one row per URL, one URL per row. VALID means 'passed every gate', NOT 'renderable today': see renderable_today and by_status.

reconciliation.note_on_funnel_reconciles_false: 1M-SUMMARY.json says funnel_reconciles: false. That flag is a FORMULA defect, not a data defect: the climate grid-cell gate appends its 31,555 REJECTED_SAME_CLIMATE_GRID_CELL rows to the quality-gate list AFTER raw_total is taken, and the hand-kept formula assumed that list equals generated - raw. The data reconcile exactly (above). The formula was corrected on 2026-10-21 to sum every recorded rejection group from ROW_GROUPS; the flag will read true on the next builder run. The builder was NOT re-run to write this file.

demand_basis.rule: DEMAND_PROVEN only on evidence that names THIS entity (clickstream readers of its own article, 'Admitted on demand', or a measured keyword containing its name). local_volume and market_demand_evidence are FAMILY x MARKET cells and never count as per-page demand. Pages about one thing without such evidence are UTILITY_PROVEN; pages about a set or a pair are AGGREGATION.

renderable_today.meaning: 975,677 of the 1,002,362 cannot be served until a model builder exists for their family. The renderer, not the inventory, is the binding constraint on publication.

open_qa_items_meaning: These are measured on SIMULATED English title/meta/H1 skeletons. Real copy is written per market by the page builder at cohort time, and cohort QA (scripts/atlas/cohort-qa.mjs) is the gate that must reach 0 failures before any page is published.

authoritative_files.monolith_note: Over GitHub's 100 MB limit, so regenerated by the builder or reassembled from the parts (see the parts index 'to_reassemble').

standing_rules: No Ahrefs, Semrush, DataForSEO, Ubersuggest or any paid SEO/keyword subscription.
Production changes only when the owner explicitly asks.
A page qualifies through REAL DEMAND or REAL UTILITY; never fabricate demand, volume or facts. Unknown volume is null, never 0.
No translation-only pages, no city-name swaps, no stop-to-stop transport noise, no weakened duplicate or quality gates.
The 23,453 climate city-name-swap rows stay out.
